operation_details.item: The user's Client A runs its finance systems on SAP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the client work going today? Still sorting through the finance-system notes?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I’m cleaning up the client profiles before the next round of conversations.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What have you confirmed so far?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Client A runs its finance systems on SAP. Client B uses Oracle, and Client C uses NetSuite.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s useful. Are you keeping those details in the client profiles rather than in a separate working document?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the system details are recorded in the client profiles. I’m trying to keep the notes practical instead of building another elaborate framework.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. A clean reference is probably more useful here than a polished model no one checks.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I just need the basics to be accurate before we discuss process improvements.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that Client A runs on SAP, while keeping the system details for Clients B and C.
